name: pincel-e-guia
description: Pincel & Guia — storefront + admin. Projeto VORTEXIS.

scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace=@pincel/storefront
scripts.build:admin: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace=@pincel/admin
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:admin
scripts.check: npm run check:boundaries && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.db:setup: prisma migrate dev --name init --schema packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma && tsx seed/rbac.ts && tsx seed/demo.ts
scripts.db:reset: prisma migrate reset --force --schema packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma && tsx seed/rbac.ts && tsx seed/demo.ts
